content.value_statement: Pair programming workflows can become uneven, untracked, or hard to verify. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through roles, modes, tests, reviews, and session records.
actual_capabilities: Starts sessions in driver, navigator, switch, TDD, review, mentor, and debug modes.
Documents commands for tests, coverage, reviews, performance checks, navigation, git actions, and role changes.
Defines configuration examples for verification, testing, review, git, session, and AI partner settings.
Provides session examples for authentication, memory leak debugging, TDD, refactoring, performance, and API development.
Explains session persistence, background sessions, templates, custom commands, and environment overrides.
limitations: Requires the Claude Flow CLI and a compatible project setup.
Actual behavior depends on installed tools and project configuration.
Git, test, and CI examples need user approval and local safeguards.
It does not replace human review for security-sensitive or production code.

use_cases.title: Guide Feature Work
use_cases.description: Structure a feature session with roles, implementation steps, tests, review, and a final verification summary.

use_cases.title: Teach Development Patterns
use_cases.description: Use mentor mode to explain code choices, compare alternatives, and help a learner practice safely.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Refactoring Reviews
use_cases.description: Plan legacy code changes, preserve behavior with tests, check complexity, and document review outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Start A Guided Session
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner session for a small change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the pair-programming skill in driver mode. Help me implement a small change, explain each step, and ask before running commands.

prompt_templates.title: Plan A TDD Feature
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate feature work with tests first.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use TDD mode for this feature. Start with expected behavior, propose test cases, guide implementation, and verify coverage after each cycle.

prompt_templates.title: Review And Refactor
prompt_templates.prompt: Use review mode to inspect this module. Identify risks, suggest a refactoring plan, preserve behavior with tests, and summarize tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate A Full Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a switch-mode pair session for this project. Track roles, testing, security review, performance checks, session notes, and final handoff items.

output_examples.input: I need help adding JWT authentication with tests.
output_examples.output: The assistant starts a switch-mode session, outlines roles, proposes authentication steps, requests approval before commands, and tracks tests and review items.

output_examples.input: Our Node service has a memory leak.
output_examples.output: The assistant guides a debug session, profiles likely causes, proposes listener cleanup, adds regression tests, and summarizes verification results.
The assistant creates a refactoring plan, protects current behavior with tests, checks complexity, and prepares a review summary.

best_practices: Define the session goal, mode, and expected verification before changing code.
Run tests and reviews after each meaningful change.
Keep human approval for git, CI, dependency, and deployment actions.
anti_patterns: Starting a long session without a clear goal or stopping point.
Letting generated code bypass tests, review, or security checks.
Using auto-commit or background actions without repository safeguards.

faq.question: Does this skill execute commands automatically?
faq.answer: The skill itself is documentation. Actual command execution depends on the active agent, installed tools, and user approval settings.

faq.question: Can I use it without Claude Flow?
faq.answer: It is designed for the Claude Flow CLI. Without that CLI, the commands are useful as workflow guidance.

faq.question: Which pair programming modes are included?
faq.answer: It covers driver, navigator, switch, TDD, review, mentor, and debug modes.

faq.question: Can it help with test-driven development?
faq.answer: Yes. The TDD workflow guides test planning, implementation, refactoring, coverage checks, and repeated verification.

faq.question: Does it replace a human code review?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure review work, but human review remains important for production and security-sensitive changes.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production projects?
faq.answer: Yes, when paired with normal safeguards such as approvals, tests, branch protection, and CI checks.
